notes: Concept geometry only; no member, reinforcement, footing or earthquake safety certification.
Design brief includes one future occupied second floor plus its roof; future loads and foundations require engineering design now.
Original structure discarded at owner request. Source architecture retained separately; coordinated alternative changes rooms.
Assumed plot origin is centred on source built-up envelope; boundary survey and setbacks must be confirmed.
Column and beam sizes are coordination envelopes, not approved sizes. Reinforcement intentionally not specified.
240 cm footing rectangles are spatial reservations only, not designed foundations.
60 cm loaded perimeter slab extensions and additional 76.2 cm roof shade where space permits: do not treat as foundation counterweights.
No RC wall, column or beam may be removed for future partition changes.
Stair landing, guards and headroom require architectural/structural detailing; the 3D stair is a space reservation only.
